DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Leukemia

The combination of a 4-year-old female presenting with prolonged fatigue, easy bruising, high fever, and severe bone pain is highly suggestive of acute leukemia. Given her age and the specific constellation of symptoms, this is the most critical diagnosis to consider. I am proceeding with immediate diagnostic workup to confirm this suspicion.
